author: Good Enough
description:
Cauterization was one of the most painful medical treatments of the Middle Ages. When a wound wouldn't stop bleeding, medieval barber-surgeons often pressed a red-hot iron against the injury to seal it shut, causing intense pain but sometimes preventing fatal blood loss. This Short explores one of history's most brutal medical procedures and why it remained a common treatment for centuries.

Discover how medieval surgeons treated severe wounds before modern medicine and why surviving the treatment could be almost as terrifying as the injury itself.
title: The Most Painful Medieval Treatment 🔥😲 #didyouknow #history #facts #medieval
